nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Dr. Jide Idris, Director General of the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (#NCDC), assured that Nigeria is not under serious threat from Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV). 
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #Nigeria

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Speaking on Sunrise Daily, Idris highlighted that HMPV, while not new, is less widely recognized and is known to cause respiratory infections, particularly in vulnerable groups such as young children, the elderly, and those with weakened immune systems.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠The @NCDC, in collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Health and partners, has classified the risk level as moderate following a recent risk assessment. Preventive measures include monitoring, public advisories, and guidance from the World #Health Organization. 
Overcrowded and poorly ventilated environments are noted as high-risk areas for HMPV transmission.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #Nigeria

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠The @NCDC is actively monitoring the HMPV situation, maintaining a moderate risk level and implementing safety measures. 
Public health authorities urge #Nigerians to remain vigilant and practice hygiene measures to minimize transmission #risk.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #Nigeria
